name: AAPW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a tournament from Night of Champions I through Night of Champions II (3 March 1997, Matt "Techman" Sutherland over Wayne Hanson); changed hands three more times across the year (two chained in this delta's own held pages), closing 1997 with Wayne Hanson as champion after a four-way elimination at Madison Square Garden.

name: AAPW Atlantic Championship
epitaph: The fed's secondary singles belt and its hottest: five reigns traced across the year (two chained in this delta's own held pages), vacated once when the champion is removed from the fed, and closing 1997 with "The Demon" Damien Lestat as champion after winning the vacant title at Invasion.

name: AAPW Television Championship
epitaph: Crowned in a four-way at Night of Champions II (The Crow; one reign chained in this delta's own held pages); five further reigns traced by the DEDICATED-AAPW digest, closing 1997 with "Cactus" Bubba Steed as champion after a no-DQ-for-the-champion win at the first Invasion.

name: AAPW Light-Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Created June 1997; "Dashing" Derek Lankford wins the inaugural tournament final (23 July, off-page), turning on his own stable in the same segment; The Crow wins a three-way to close the year (16 December, chained in this delta's own held pages).

name: AAPW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Crowned in the Double Trouble tournament (27 January, The Stylistics; two reigns chained in this delta's own held pages); three further reigns traced by the DEDICATED-AAPW digest, closing 1997 with The Punishers as two-time champions -- "the first two-time AAPW tag team champions," their own words.

name: AAPW Atlantic Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Created July 1997; The Suicide Blondes win a four-way dance for the inaugural title (23 July, off-page), retaining through three defenses before The Trailer Park Assassins win it 16 December (chained in this delta's own held pages).
